channel.title: Philly Panic Index
channel.description: A daily index of panic surrounding the Eagles, Phillies, Sixers and Flyers. Official prints and research notes.

item.title: PPI 61.3, up 1.1. CONCERNED. Nov 24 official print
item.description: The Sixers lost 128-111 to Portland; the Eagles listed Mitchell, Jones, Ebiketie and Mondon as estimated DNPs.

item.title: PPI 60.2, down 2.1. CONCERNED. Nov 23 official print
item.description: The Eagles beat Pittsburgh 19-16 to end a seven-game losing streak; Saquon Barkley left with an upper-body injury.

item.title: PPI 62.3, down 0.6. CONCERNED. Nov 22 official print
item.description: The Flyers beat Montreal 4-3 for their third straight win; Noah Cates scored with 31 seconds left.

item.title: PPI 62.9, unchanged. CONCERNED. Nov 21 official print
item.description: Eagles ruled Zack Baun and Dontayvion Wicks out; Sixers forward Dominick Barlow was upgraded to probable.

item.title: PPI 62.9, down 0.6. CONCERNED. Nov 20 official print
item.description: The Flyers erased a 5-2 third-period deficit to beat Ottawa 6-5 in overtime, their fourth win in six games.

item.title: PPI 63.5, down 0.5. CONCERNED. Nov 19 official print
item.description: The Sixers rallied from 17 down to beat Orlando 121-116 and improve to 13-3; DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks returned to Eagles practice.

item.title: PPI 64.0, down 0.4. CONCERNED. Nov 18 official print
item.description: Flyers rallied from two one-goal deficits to beat Buffalo 4-3 and improve to 3-1-1 over five games; Jaylen Brown is out against Orlando with a left hamstring strain.

item.title: PPI 64.4, down 0.9. CONCERNED. Nov 17 official print
item.description: The Sixers beat Brooklyn 135-123 to improve to 12-3, their best 15-game start since 2000-01; Joel Embiid scored a season-high 37.

item.title: PPI 65.3, down 0.1. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 16 official print
item.description: The Sixers beat Indiana 131-124 to improve to 11-3; the Flyers fell 5-2 to Edmonton after allowing two first-period power-play goals.

item.title: PPI 65.4, down 0.9. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 15 official print
item.description: The Flyers rallied from 2-0 down to beat Columbus 4-3 and finish their road trip 2-1-2; Joel Embiid is out against Indiana.

item.title: PPI 66.3, down 2.3. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 14 official print
item.description: The Eagles waived Hollywood Brown and Fred Johnson, leaving four open roster spots and reinforcing the shift from competitive panic to lost-season evaluation.

item.title: PPI 68.6, down 1.3. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 13 official print
item.description: Sixers rallied from 17 down to beat Toronto 123-112, restoring some confidence as Embiid returned and finished the game; the Eagles' bye-week collapse remains the dominant citywide risk.

item.title: PPI 69.9, up 0.5. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 12 official print
item.description: Questionable designations for Joel Embiid and LeBron James raised Sixers availability risk; disputed Matvei Michkov trade reporting raised Flyers roster anxiety despite a strong overtime effort in Edmonton.

item.title: PPI 69.4, up 2.2. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 11 official print
item.description: Boston routed the Sixers 123-101 with the principal lineup available; the Eagles’ deadline ended without a broader fire sale.

item.title: PPI 67.2, down 4.3. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 10 official print
item.description: The Eagles began shifting from acute panic toward acceptance by trading Jordan Davis for future premium picks; the Flyers’ 3-1 win supplied additional relief.

item.title: PPI 71.5, down 0.4. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 9 official print
item.description: The Eagles' offense remained broken in a seventh straight loss; the city reading still eased because the 9-2 Sixers rebounded, partly offset by another Flyers late collapse.

item.title: PPI 71.9, unchanged. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 8 official print
item.description: No new event changed a component score; the Eagles remain at maximum entering Joe Milton's first NFL start during a six-game losing streak.

item.title: PPI 71.9, up 1.5. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 7 official print
item.description: The Sixers were routed 119-95 in Cleveland, fell to 8-2 and 1-1 in NBA Cup play, and got 14 combined points from Joel Embiid and LeBron James.

item.title: PPI 70.4, up 0.4. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 6 official print
item.description: The Flyers blew a 2-1 third-period lead, lost 3-2 to the Rangers and fell to 4-10-4, with five losses in six games.

item.title: PPI 70.0, down 0.4. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 5 official print
item.description: The Sixers improved to 8-1 and avenged their only loss with a 112-106 win, while the Eagles' switch to Joe Milton and seven DNPs kept football panic at the maximum.

item.title: PPI 70.4, up 0.2. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 4 official print
item.description: The Flyers fell 4-2 after another poor start and slipped to 4-9-4, partially offset by Embiid coming off the Sixers' injury report ahead of Detroit.

item.title: PPI 70.2, down 0.6. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 3 official print
item.description: The Sixers improved to 7-1 with a balanced 126-107 win and Embiid's return, while Phillies roster anxiety rose slightly after Bohm reached free agency without a qualifying offer.

item.title: PPI 70.8, down 0.3. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 2 official print
item.description: The Eagles lost their sixth straight and fell to last place after surrendering 27 unanswered, while the Flyers’ six-goal win and Konecny’s two-point return supplied partial relief.

item.title: PPI 71.1, down 0.8. HIGH ANXIETY. Nov 1 official print
item.description: The shorthanded Sixers improved to 6-1 behind Tyrese Maxey’s 38 points, while Konecny and Tippett moved closer to returning for the Flyers.

item.title: PPI 71.9, down 1.0. HIGH ANXIETY. Oct 31 official print
item.description: The Sixers beat the champion Knicks 98-93 without Jaylen Brown, while Barkley and several Eagles defenders were cleared and two Flyers scorers returned to practice.

item.title: PPI 72.9, up 0.3. HIGH ANXIETY. Oct 30 official print
item.description: Jaylen Brown is questionable for tonight’s NBA Cup opener with left knee soreness while the Eagles’ six DNPs remained out of Thursday practice.

item.title: PPI 72.6, up 0.1. HIGH ANXIETY. Oct 29 official print
item.description: The Flyers lost a third straight game and a 12th time in 15, offsetting the relief from the Sixers’ comeback win in Indiana.

item.title: Research: Eagles: Buy, Sell or Hold?
item.description: Five straight losses and a trade deadline approaching. The PPI Risk Desk weighs three options for a distressed asset: buy, sell or hold.

item.title: PPI 72.5, down 0.6. HIGH ANXIETY. Oct 28 official print
item.description: Joel Embiid and VJ Edgecombe cleared the injury report, partially offset by the Flyers’ second straight loss after another poor start.

item.title: PPI 73.1, up 1.5. HIGH ANXIETY. Oct 27 official print
item.description: The Eagles lost a fifth straight game, 38-21 to Dallas, after surrendering the final 18 points; Saquon Barkley and Britain Covey also left with injuries.

item.title: PPI 71.6, up 2.0. HIGH ANXIETY. Oct 26 official print
item.description: The Sixers’ 3-0 start ended in a wire-to-wire 106-93 loss to Detroit while Joel Embiid, VJ Edgecombe and Jabari Walker were unavailable.

item.title: Research: The Sixers are 2–0. The vibes are at a record high. The Risk Desk Has Doubts.
item.description: Two games in, the Sixers have beaten two good teams and erased a 29-point deficit. The Risk Desk has requested further evidence before reserving its spot on the parade route.

item.title: Research: PPI Fan Asset Disposition Policy
item.description: Formal guidance from the PPI Risk Desk on the disposition of baseballs entering the seating area.
